summary: BIB-0027 appearance redo: design proposals marked pending_H2 in the CGI-animal appearance cards, to be put on the H2 sign-off page.

items.proposal: Option A: a real frog body at dream size (75-85 cm standing, matched to the four-foot house). Sits upright, stands for the bow, hops. Livery tailored to the frog, bare webbed feet, powdered curled wig on the frog head.
items.alternatives: B: a frog that walks on two legs throughout (more humanised); C: natural size with no livery (not recommended).

items.proposal: Option A: a photoreal cod head and scaled skin on an upright figure with two short legs in breeches, fin-edged hands and the tail fin showing; 80-90 cm, the same height as the Frog-Footman.
items.alternatives: B: upright on its tail fin, gliding, with no legs; C: another species with the same body plan.

items.proposal: The pig end-state is a photoreal CGI piglet (pink-white, pale blue-grey eyes kept from the infant). Option A: an imperceptible CGI drift from infant to piglet within the single continuous SUP-006 shot.
items.alternatives: B: a hidden handover to the CGI piglet at ch006-p48, with no morph.

items.proposal: The ear-to-ear grin is the one licensed departure from real cat anatomy. The lips retract along the whole jaw to show a real cat's full set of teeth; jaw and teeth stay real.
items.risk: This is where the Cat is most likely to read as a cartoon face, against the SUP-002 limit.

items.proposal: Pat (human) handles the tied ladders and the barrow while the CGI animals help as their bodies allow. No animal carries a ladder upright. Final staging is for 07-directing.

design_conventions_to_confirm: Talking animals are built at species-true size. The text's relative-size beats are met through Alice's SUP-003 scale changes. Two dream-scale exceptions: the Footmen, sized to the four-foot house, and the Gryphon and Mock Turtle, which have no real counterpart.

Clothing is dropped everywhere the text gives none. The retained props are: the White Rabbit's waistcoat, watch, gloves and fan, spectacles, and his trumpet and tabard at the trial; the Magpie's muffler, which the text implies; the Footmen's livery and wigs; the Caterpillar's hookah; and the jurors' slates.

routing_note: Surface on the H2 sign-off page next to the BIB-0027 scope items. Nothing is blocked; downstream may proceed on the Option A proposals.
